claims.behavior: The fixture check detects the fault and passes after restoration.
claims.precondition: The public command-only fixture is available.
claims.expected: The unchanged fixture-ready assertion passes after the fault is removed.
claims.case: An ignored fault marker changes fixture state, not source or assertions.

controls.expectation: The same assertion fails with the fault marker and passes without it.

limits: Scripted public fixture proof only; no agent speed, browser, database or human-usability claim.
The ignored marker is an environment control, not a product-source mutation.
